query:
SELECT e.fullName, a.date, a.shiftLabel, a.clockInTime, a.clockOutTime, a.status
FROM attendance a
JOIN employees e ON e.id = a.employeeId
WHERE e.fullName LIKE '%張喆翔%'
  AND a.date >= '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY a.date DESC, a.clockInTime DESC
LIMIT 10;
